title: T3 — Benefits diagram
body:
# T3 — Benefits diagram

## Goals and outcomes

The PM path's goal is an auditable request-to-closure loop; the outcome is that no gate, baseline
or acceptance in the programme moves without a recorded, distinct decision.

## Measures

- Every gate carries a `rule` decision under a published delegation (measured by the approval
  ledger).
- A baseline mutation after the frozen baseline cites an approved change (measured by the change
  rows).
- Closure resolves against the baseline (measured by the closure gate's evidence).

## Benefits and sub-benefits

The programme benefits served: B1 (auditable decisions) directly; B6 (the coverage the record
gives) and B7 (through fewer rework loops) indirectly. The sub-benefits are the five accepted T3
deliverables.
